name: The St. Regis Osaka
positioning: St. Regis hotel on Osaka's Midosuji Boulevard, in a 27-story building designed by Nikken Sekkei, a one-minute walk from Hommachi Station
best_for: Travelers who want a central Osaka base with direct subway access
Guests who value butler service, 24-hour breakfast and in-hotel dining

facts.text: The hotel sits on Midosuji Boulevard, with access to an Osaka Metro station connecting to three subway lines.
The hotel is a one-minute walk from Exit 7 of Hommachi Station on the Osaka Metro, in a building with direct underground access.
The building was designed by Japanese architecture firm Nikken Sekkei and stands 27 stories above Midosuji Avenue.
Guestroom headboards are made of Kawashima silk with motifs of gingko and cherry blossoms.
Rooms have walk-in closets and spacious bathrooms with Japanese-style bathtubs.
La Veduta is an Italian restaurant with an interior inspired by a Tuscan villa.
Brasserie RÉGINE is a modern French brasserie.
Teppanyaki WAJO showcases premium Japanese beef, Seto Inland Sea seafood and seasonal Kyoto vegetables.
Breakfast is served 24 hours a day.
The IRIDIUM featuring SOTHYS spa is on the 14th floor.
Spa treatments are given by aestheticians trained at the Sothys Institut in Paris.
The hotel's afternoon tea evolves through the seasons, with distinctive themes and occasional collaborations.

highlights.text: Behind The St. Regis Bar, a mural of Osaka's past and present, styled after Scenes In and Around Kyoto, features the hotel itself.
The St. Regis Suite uses bespoke Nishijin-ori silk and gold accents.
The St. Regis Garden on the 12th floor is inspired by traditional Japanese stone garden architecture.
The hotel's signature Bloody Mary is the Shogun Mary, made with yuzu, wasabi powder and soy sauce.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service; the closest airport is Osaka International Airport, Itami.
Osaka Castle is about a half hour from the hotel on foot.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury positioning with premium pricing.
